critical_code_review_comments: Login endpoint does not enforce is_active; only get_current_user rejects inactive users after login. Consider blocking login for inactive users to give clearer feedback.
No brute-force lockout implemented (spec did not require it). If aiming for playbook compliance, add attempt counter + timed lockout.
seed_demo_users only seeds when no non-admin users exist; if admin manually deletes both demo users, they will be re-seeded on next startup (acceptable, but worth noting).
public_user relies on '_id' being present; safe here because it's only called on freshly-fetched docs.
CORS still includes hardcoded http://localhost:3000; harmless but consider deriving from env only.

success_rate.frontend: ~99% (all critical role-based flows, user mgmt, CSV controls, and Excel export verified; PDF export not captured by test harness but no error)
